meta.name: process:two_sources_reconciliation
meta.description: 231 (stage U, U2c; the owner's decision of 2026-10-28: a chain is a multi-step process): an own party's period in one case: invoices come from a folder and from a mailbox, the bank statements side by side, and once all three are done, the reconciliation pairs them, as the workflow template of the same name was (configs/workflows.json until then). Each step runs a case of its own process, a sub-case (run_case@1), and waits until it closes; a paid run of a sub-case waits for a person's start with its cost cap.

changelog.note: 231 (U2c): the first version: four sub-case steps (the incoming invoices from a folder, the emails of a mailbox, the bank statements, then the reconciliation after all three) and its tabs: Overview, History; started by hand for a party and a period, each of the first three steps with its own source.

title: Monthly reconciliation with invoices from a folder and a mailbox
summary: An own party's period in one case: invoices from a folder and from a mailbox and the bank statements are read side by side, then reconciled.
